meta.input_provenance: Every frame in this report is synthesized from epbr2026_DBC_v1.0.dbc (D-01) via telemetry.synth.generator.SyntheticFrameSource -- this is a modelled stream, not a captured vehicle log.
meta.known_limitation: Payload entropy is exactly the quantity this gate exists to measure, and synthetic data has only the entropy the model in config/gate.json's entropy_brackets gives it. The compensating controls are the three-bracket (best/typical/worst) band reported below and the D-14 worst-case re-check against real captured traffic in Phase 1.
meta.bus_assignment_caveat: bus_assignment.confirmed is False: epbr2026_DBC_v1.0.dbc names no per-message bus, so which of these messages rides bus1 vs bus2 is a human-authored ECU-sender proxy, not a DBC-derived fact (see config/gate.json bus_assignment._note).
meta.bus_targets_caveat: bus_targets.confirmed is False: the combined bus frame rate this run's rate model targets is prose-sourced (telemetry_conversation.md/CLAUDE.md), not derivable from epbr2026_DBC_v1.0.dbc -- see config/gate.json bus_targets._note and 00-THRESHOLD.md's pre-registered header-overhead risk.
